NYC_ECONSULT_2021.population: 19 NYC Health+Hospitals specialty clinics, 2017-2019 rollout, 12 months before/after
NYC_ECONSULT_2021.boundary: No completed-visit benefit established; not equivalence. Resolved-without-visit requests are legitimate distinct outcome, not failed care. No mortality outcome.

VA_DUAL_ELIGIBLE_2023.population: VA+Medicare eligible veterans age65+, emergency ambulance rides, restricted nearby hospital choice and prior VA use
VA_DUAL_ELIGIBLE_2023.boundary: Published estimated local effect for ambulance-destination compliers under IV assumptions, not Medicaid/nonveterans/all elective care. Spending includes VA costs and Medicare/provider payments, not patient wealth or take-home income. OLS and IV target different estimands; do not treat difference as quantified selection bias. No source microdata rerun.

FQHC_LOOKALIKE_2023.population: Hope Family Care Center Kansas City, all primary care encounters in 15 months
FQHC_LOOKALIKE_2023.boundary: No statistically established completion difference; not equivalence. Completion conditional on referral; initiation selection and repeated encounters matter. Do not infer wealth from payer or compute patient-risk using encounter counts. Exact payer-specific referral event denominators not supplied in extracted table.
